title: digest_migration
description: Digest projection of a migration / versioning artifact (changelog/migrations/** or other migration_versioning slice files that are not the top-level unreleased changelog). Captures the migration kind, affected canonical entities, target toolkit version, and breaking-change flag for K1/K3 drift checks.

digest_type.description: Discriminator constant identifying this as a migration digest.

source_file.description: Relative path of the source file from the toolkit root.

source_sha.description: 40-character git blob SHA of the source file at extraction time.

extractor_version.description: Semver version of the extractor script that produced this digest.

extracted_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when this digest was produced.

migration_path.description: Echo of source_file for ergonomic downstream lookup.

kind.description: Inferred migration category. Derived from filename hints (added/changed/deprecated/removed/fixed) or section headings inside the file. 'unknown' when no signal is present.

affected_entities.description: Canonical IDs mentioned in the file (matches the cn:... / fr-... / api-... / nfr-... / inv-... patterns).

target_version.description: Toolkit version associated with this migration if inferable from the filename (e.g. v0.4.0.md) or a 'target version' line in the body. Absent when not inferable.

is_breaking.description: True when the file declares a breaking change (filename or content contains 'breaking', or a 'Breaking' heading is present).
